subject: Request: admin activity audit extract and secure delivery
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <security@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin activity logs for SOC2 / SIG evidence

Hi Vanessa,

We're compiling audit evidence for an upcoming SOC 2 review and the SIG response. Can you provide admin-activity exports for the last 12 months covering: role changes, console logins, API key activity, policy changes, and delegated admin actions? For compliance we need:

- CSV/parquet extracts that include a pseudonymized user identifier (HMAC or tokenized) rather than raw emails
- A documented retention window and proof of retention policy enforcement
- Chain-of-custody manifest and SHA256 checksums for delivered files
- Encryption-in-transit and at-rest details; KMS key usage preferred
- Delivery options: direct S3 upload (SSE-KMS), presigned URLs, or signed transfer to our secure bucket

Attached is our SIG questionnaire section for audit logs (SIG_questionnaire.xlsx). Please let us know what you can deliver, expected timelines, and any limitations (sampling, redaction, or retained-only-snapshots).

Best,
Alex Morgan
Security Engineer
Greenleaf Health

--

(Attachment: SIG_questionnaire.xlsx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <security@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs for SOC2 / SIG evidence

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and attachment. We can deliver an export package that satisfies the items you listed. High-level options and constraints below: 

Deliverables we propose:
- A sample extract (1 week) and full 12-month package (10 business days)
- File format: compressed parquet files plus a CSV manifest (sample_manifest.csv) with row counts and SHA256 checksums
- Pseudonymization: HMAC-SHA256 using a customer-specific salt (we will not deliver raw email addresses). We can also provide a keyed-hash map for in-house mapping if you need re-identification under a legal process.
- Encryption & delivery: SSE-KMS on S3. We can either upload to your provided ARN-restricted bucket or provide presigned PUT URLs (72-hour expiry). Please advise which you prefer.
- Chain-of-custody: export job logs, operator id, approval ticket id, and signed manifest (we sign the manifest file with our internal export key).
- Retention evidence: we will include an extract of retention policy enforcement logs and a snapshot proving that older events were purged according to policy.

Limitations / notes:
- Due to our production retention model, very old high-volume raw telemetry may be sampled — we will call out any sampled time ranges in the manifest.
- For on-demand re-identification we require a legal & security approval flow.

I copied Marissa (Product Ops) who will coordinate the export job and Connor (Security Ops) for KMS/manifest signing details on the internal thread. Attached is a short paper outlining our export options (redwood_export_options_v1.pdf).

If you confirm SSE-KMS and provide the target bucket ARN and a preferred delivery window, we'll schedule the sample export for next week.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer GTM
Redwood Inference

--

(Attachment: redwood_export_options_v1.pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs for SOC2 / SIG evidence

Vanessa — internal notes / proposed technical plan below. I'll run the export once we have Alex's confirmation on the bucket ARN and KMS key.

Proposed export pipeline:
- Export job will materialize daily parquet shards (bzip2) for the requested date range; we'll concatenate to produce the 12-month package.
- Pseudonymization: generate HMAC-SHA256(user_email, customer_salt) where customer_salt is stored in HSM/KMS-wrapped secrets. Salt is unique per customer; we do not store a reversible mapping in the export.
- Manifest: sample_manifest.csv containing file_name, rows, sha256_hex, start_ts, end_ts, export_job_id, operator_id. We'll sign manifest using our export signing key and attach signature.asc.
- Delivery: preferred flow is to upload to customer S3 with SSE-KMS (customer-managed key). If the customer requests presigned URLs, we'll generate time-limited PUTs (72h) and deliver via signed email.
- Chain-of-custody: attach audit record that shows who requested, who approved (ticket HB-4821), the operator who executed the export, and the timestamped delivery events.
- Retention proof: provide a snapshot of the retention enforcement ledger showing purge jobs and their scope; include hash of that snapshot in manifest.
- Failure modes: failed shards will be moved to DLQ/secure bucket; we'll surface DLQ counts in the manifest and can rerun snapshot exports if requested.

Attachments: export_playbook.md (contains runbook steps, operator checklist, and rollback steps).

Questions for Connor: do we have a standard for signing manifests (PGP vs. RSA)? Also, what's our maximum export rate to avoid impacting production (we'll throttle to 200 MB/s per export by default).

-marissa

--

(Attachment: export_playbook.md)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs for SOC2 / SIG evidence

Marissa / Vanessa — quick answers: 
- Manifest signing: we use an RSA 4096 keypair stored in HSM. We'll produce signature.asc (detached).
- KMS: we can support customer-managed CMKs (cross-account upload with key policy) or use our key and wrap with customer public key if they prefer not to share key access. For audit delivery SSE-KMS with their ARN is the cleanest for chain-of-custody.
- Re-identification: if Greenleaf requests reversible mapping later, we require an approval ticket and will only release via a legal/POC channel; logs of that release are appended to the chain-of-custody.

Operational limits: 200 MB/s cap, export jobs will run in a controlled maintenance window to avoid noisy neighbor effects.

-Connor

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <security@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity logs for SOC2 / SIG evidence

Hi Alex — thanks again. Based on the internal plan above, here's the proposed delivery and next steps: 

1) You confirm: target S3 bucket ARN (arn:aws:s3:::greenleaf-audit-exports) and CMK ARN (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef12-3456-7890).
2) We will produce a sample extract (first 30 days) with pseudonymized IDs and the signed manifest within 5 business days.
3) After your review of the sample we will produce the full 12-month package (10 business days).
4) Manifest will include SHA256 checksums, export_job_id, operator_id, and a chain-of-custody CSV. Files will be uploaded with SSE-KMS and we will send a signed delivery confirmation email with presigned GETs for verification if needed.

Link to delivery instructions and checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-sample-link (will populate with the sample manifest and instructions).

Please reply to confirm the bucket/KMS ARN and whether you want us to use cross-account upload or presigned PUTs. Once confirmed we'll kick off the sample.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer GTM
Redwood Inference

--

(Attachment: sample_manifest.csv)
